gender_female_count_geo20.long_description: Population gender distribution from ACS 5-year estimates, table B01001 (Sex by Age). Male (B01001_002) and female (B01001_026) population counts are directly tabulated. Percentages are calculated relative to total population (B01001_001). Values are available at Census tract, county, and block group levels on both Census 2020 and Census 2010 geography boundaries. Pre-2020 values on 2020 boundaries have been standardized using area-weighted crosswalks.
